sloka: नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्य सदश्वान् पर्वतोपमान् ।जघानाप्लुत्य गदया रावणस्य विभीषणः ।। ६.१०१.१७ ।।
transliteration: nīlameghanibhāṁścāsya sadaśvān parvatopamān ।jaghānāplutya gadayā rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.17 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana struck with his formidable mace the horses of Ravana which were like dark clouds and huge like mountains.
